sentenceSets.sentence: The full spectrum of opinion was represented in the consultation, which made consensus harder and the eventual position more defensible.

answerChoices.reasoning: Breadth indicates width or extent, but the sentence emphasizes a *range of alternatives*, not merely the width of coverage.
Range is very close in meaning, describing a series of alternatives, but 'spectrum' adds the sense of a continuum from one end to the other.
Variety means different kinds, but spectrum emphasizes a *continuous arrangement* of positions, not merely different types.
Array indicates an ordered display, but spectrum emphasizes a continuum from extreme to extreme, not just an arrangement of items.
Collection means a gathering of items, but it does not capture the sense of a continuous spectrum from one pole to another.
Assortment indicates a mix of different types, but spectrum emphasizes a *continuum* rather than discrete types.
Mixture means a blend of ingredients, but spectrum emphasizes a continuous range of positions, not merely blended elements.
Gamut indicates the complete range or scope, but it is more abstract than spectrum's sense of a continuous arrangement.
Consensus means agreement; the opposite of the full spectrum of *differing* opinions.
Uniformity means sameness; the opposite of a spectrum representing diverse and opposing viewpoints.
Singularity means uniqueness or oneness; the opposite of a spectrum representing multiple perspectives.

sentenceSets.sentence: The political spectrum in the country ranged from far left to far right.

answerChoices.reasoning: Ideology indicates a system of beliefs, but the sentence emphasizes a *range* from left to right, not a single belief system.
Divide indicates a separation into opposing groups, but spectrum emphasizes a *continuum* from one end to the other, not just two sides.
Landscape indicates a general configuration, but spectrum emphasizes a *linear arrangement* from extreme to extreme.
Alignment suggests positioning or arrangement, but spectrum emphasizes a *continuous* political range, not just positioning.
Tendency indicates a leaning in a direction, but spectrum emphasizes a full *continuum* from left to right.
Orientation indicates direction or positioning, but spectrum emphasizes a full range, not individual positioning.
Branch suggests a division or type, but spectrum emphasizes a continuous arrangement rather than discrete branches.
Faction indicates a group or party, but spectrum emphasizes a continuous range, not individual groups.
Center suggests a middle point; the opposite of a spectrum ranging from far left to far right.
Extremism emphasizes one end of a spectrum; the sentence indicates the full range from left to right.
Moderation suggests middle-of-the-road positions; the opposite of a spectrum spanning far left to far right.

sentenceSets.sentence: The spectrum of symptoms presented by autism varies widely among individuals.

answerChoices.reasoning: Range indicates a series of items, but spectrum emphasizes a *continuum* of severity or manifestation, not just different options.
Set indicates a collection of items, but spectrum emphasizes a continuous variation in intensity or expression.
Array suggests an ordered arrangement, but spectrum emphasizes a *continuous* variation across individuals.
Catalog suggests a list of items, but spectrum emphasizes variations along a continuum, not a discrete list.
Collection indicates gathered items, but spectrum emphasizes *varied expression* along a continuum.
Profile suggests a description of characteristics, but spectrum emphasizes a *range of variation* rather than a single profile.
Manifestation indicates how something appears, but spectrum emphasizes the *breadth of variation*, not single manifestations.
Presentation suggests how something is displayed, but spectrum emphasizes the *continuous variation* across individuals.
Uniformity means sameness; the opposite of a spectrum of varied symptoms among individuals.
Consistency suggests sameness across instances; the opposite of wide variation in how autism presents.
Homogeneity means all the same; the opposite of a spectrum of varied symptoms presenting differently.
